defs.def: the amount of space that an object or a substance fills; the amount of space that a container has 体积；容积；容量
the amount of sth 量；额
the amount of sound that is produced by a television, radio, etc. 音量；响度

ex.s: You might want to: • relax and make eye contact with the audience • use gestures when appropriate • vary your tone and volume 1 Select a representative from the group to deliver the speech to the class.
ex.t: 你或许想要：• 放松并与听众保持眼神交流 • 在适当的时候使用手势 • 变换你的语调和音量 1 从小组中选一名代表向全班发表演讲。

defs.def: a book, that is part of a series of books （成套书籍中的）一卷，一册

ex.s: More recently, as books have become inexpensive or even throwaway, artists have used them as the raw material for artworks — transforming covers, pages or even complete volumes into paintings and sculptures.
ex.t: 更近一些时候，随着书籍变得廉价甚至可以随意丢弃，艺术家们开始把它们用作艺术品的原材料——把封面、书页甚至整册书变成绘画和雕塑。

defs.def: a series of different issues of the same magazine, especially all the issues for one year 卷，合订本（同一杂志的一系列期刊，尤指一年的）

ex.s: The Lord of the Rings was published in three volumes in 1954 and 1955, and has become one of the world's best-selling novel 2 Every Christmas, an envelope with a North Pole stamp arrived.
ex.t: 《指环王》于 1954 年和 1955 年分三卷出版，已成为世界上最畅销的小说之一 2 每年圣诞节，一封带着北极邮戳的信封都会如期而至。

ex.s: The 7th century: Xuanzang, a Chinese monk, scholar and traveller, translated volumes of scriptures from Sanskrit to Chinese.
ex.t: 7世纪：X宗，中国道士，学者，旅行家，翻译经文各卷，从梵文译为中文。

ex.s: At its last printing, it was 20 volumes, with nearly 22,000 pages.
ex.t: 在最后一次印刷时，它共有20卷，近2.2万页。

ex.s: Murray planned for a dictionary of about 6,400 pages in four volumes, completed in 10 years.
ex.t: 默里计划编一部约6400页、分四卷、在10年内完成的词典。
